_comment: This file lists the kinds of file an Xbox 360 project can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. A project is one game.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: The game, as a disc image (.iso) of an Xbox 360 game disc. The console's own system software is not needed: Xenia stands in for it. Xenia Canary's compatibility list (github.com/xenia-canary/game-compatibility) says which games work.
